visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female speaker with short brown hair and round glasses sits in the back of a luxury vehicle. She is wearing a crisp white button-up shirt and khaki pants. She addresses the camera directly while seated against a dark grey leather headrest. (2) A sharp transition shows a close-up of a person's eye area as a white fibrous sheet mask is being carefully pressed onto the skin by a hand. (3) The scene returns to the woman in the car; she uses animated hand gestures to explain her points. The background shows blurred urban greenery passing by outside the window. (4) An educational graphic animation appears, depicting a microscopic view of skin layers where small brown oval particles (melanin) move through cellular structures. (5) The woman in the car continues her explanation, looking thoughtful and authoritative. Occasional yellow and white text overlays punctuate her speech. (6) The video concludes with a static informational screen on a white background, displaying the clinic's logo, social media handle, phone number, and physical addresses in Traditional Chinese.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Myth Debunking -> Scientific Explanation -> Expertise Reinforcement
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To clarify that whitening face masks only provide a temporary visual brightening effect due to skin hydration, and to educate the audience that real melanin reduction requires a longer 42-day biological cycle supported by consistent antioxidant treatment.
